title: VP Sara as defense witness? Up to her impeachment team – Gatchalian
summary: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Thursday said it would still depend on the defense panel’s strategy if they would let Vice President Sara Duterte testify personally in her impeachment trial…

blocks.text: Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Thursday said it would still depend on the defense panel’s strategy if they would let Vice President Sara Duterte testify personally in her impeachment trial once it resumes this November.
